facts.fact: The Net Rights Coalition, whose members include Bloggers of Zambia, Common Cause Zambia and the Zambia Free Press Initiative, said in a statement that arrests, detention and summoning of journalists under the Cyber Crimes Act No. 4 of 2025 signal a chilling environment for the media, and called for amendments to the cyber laws.
The coalition recalled that Zambia's internet shutdown of August 2021, coinciding with the presidential election, affected access to social media platforms.

note: Arrests of journalists under the Cyber Crimes Act are mentioned but the document gives no names, dates or what they said, so no punished fact.
